WITH station_values AS (
  SELECT
    station_name,
    SUM(value) AS value
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name <> 'system'
    AND timestamp BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'
  GROUP BY station_name
),

station_limits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (station_name)
    station_name,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma,
    lower_2_5sigma
  FROM (
    SELECT 'l1_buffer_a' AS station_name, mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l1_buffer_a_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_buffer_b', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l1_buffer_b_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_buffer_a', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l2_buffer_a_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_buffer_b', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l2_buffer_b_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'shuttle_station', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM shuttle_station_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_dispenser', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l1_dispenser_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_dispenser', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l2_dispenser_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_inspection', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l1_inspection_station_view

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_inspection', mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma, time
    FROM l2_inspection_station_view
  ) x
  WHERE time BETWEEN
        '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
    AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'
  ORDER BY station_name, time DESC
)

SELECT
  sv.station_name,
  sv.value,
  sl.mean,
  sl.upper_2_5sigma AS ucl,
  sl.lower_2_5sigma AS lcl,
  CASE
    WHEN sv.value > sl.upper_2_5sigma
      OR sv.value < sl.lower_2_5sigma
    THEN 'ANOMALY'
    ELSE 'NORMAL'
  END AS status
FROM station_values sv
JOIN station_limits sl
  ON sv.station_name = sl.station_name
ORDER BY sv.value DESC;

WITH station_data AS (

    SELECT 'l1_buffer_a' AS station_name, *
    FROM l1_buffer_a_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_buffer_b', *
    FROM l1_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_buffer_a', *
    FROM l2_buffer_a_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_buffer_b', *
    FROM l2_buffer_b_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'shuttle_station', *
    FROM shuttle_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_dispenser', *
    FROM l1_dispenser_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_dispenser', *
    FROM l2_dispenser_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '0 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l1_inspection', *
    FROM l1_inspection_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'l2_inspection', *
    FROM l2_inspection_cycle_nelson_view
    WHERE time BETWEEN
          '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
      AND '${anomaly_time}'::timestamptz + INTERVAL '10 seconds'
)

SELECT
    station_name,
    value,
    time,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma AS ucl,
    lower_2_5sigma AS lcl,
    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN 'ANOMALY'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS status,
    violated_rules
FROM station_data
ORDER BY value DESC;
